title: Otto Skorzeny working with the Mossad

tellings.quote: And Otto Scorzani is working with the Mossad in the early 1970s.

plain: Otto Skorzeny, a Nazi commando officer in the Second World War, was working with the Mossad, Israel's foreign spy service, in the early 1970s, according to a researcher named Jason Jorjani. He says it to Michels as a plain statement, without naming a source, in a conversation about what he calls Hitler's secret UFO programme, and it would mean former Nazis kept working with intelligence services long after the war.
